text: Help me organize a neighborhood repair session on Saturday from 10:00 to 12:00. Sam and Jules can repair bikes; Lee can handle sign-in and keep waiting visitors informed. All three are initially available for the whole session. We need a 15-minute safety briefing with everyone at the start, two 30-minute repair slots, and 15 minutes to pack up before noon. There are six booked visitors, but I do not know how many will need long repairs. Give me something useful to run the session from and make clear what I still need to decide. Do not contact anyone or make bookings.
